status_reason: WP7 preregistration draft, frozen-pending-owner-gate (see freeze). Needs E0 V2_primary PASS/PASS_PROVISIONAL, the MB-R1 rule class (I2), the paradigm (I3) and the calibration script (I4); eta_g1pedc is filled in calibration.result by one commit before the confirmatory seeds run.

freeze.rule: Every field except status, status_reason, freeze and calibration.result is frozen. tests/test_wp7_graph_policy.py recomputes frozen_content_sha256 and fails on any edit. Results are recorded as they come out, without retuning. Any change after a real-graph run is a new spec id (suffix -2) with an amendment block, and the earlier result stays on record.
freeze.owner_gate: The owner flips status draft -> preregistered in a commit that changes nothing else, after (a) the Phase 1 gate is signed off, (b) implementation items I1-I4 of the spec doc are merged and their synthetic plumbing tests pass, and (c) the sidecar files named here exist with the recorded hashes.

summary: E1: Hige 2015 in silico at KC->MBON11 (gamma1pedc). One 1-s OCT presentation paired with four 1-ms PPL101 pulses depresses MBON11's OCT response more than its MCH response; backward, DAN-only, odour-only, PPL101-silenced and plasticity-off controls leave it unchanged. Neural-level only: no body, no maze, no decoder.
backend: cuda on the GPU host for the confirmatory seeds; cpu for the parity seeds; recorded in the receipt

tau_e_s.basis: Handler 2019 (+0.5 s depresses, +6 s minimal); Hige 2015 (pulse 0.8 s after onset works)

eta_g1pedc.basis: calibration below, paired condition, calibration seeds only

tau_rec_s.basis: Hige 2015 little recovery in 40 min; Aso 2012 MP1 memory decays over ~9 h

modulator.basis: census DAN->KC synapse ROIs; PPL102 has no PED synapses, kept per design

stimulus.reset: network starts from rest once per seed; no reset inside a run (weights and state persist)
stimulus.CS_assignment: OCT is CS+ in every seed (as in Hige 2015 Fig. 1, the calibration target); the reciprocal design belongs to E2

pulses.amplitude: 2 x (V_th - V_rest) / (1 - exp(-width/tau_m)) = 2 x 7 / (1 - exp(-1/20)) = 287.1 mV-equivalent drive, i.e. twice the drive that makes an isolated resting cell reach threshold within the pulse. The refractory period (2.2 ms) exceeds the width, so a pulse can evoke at most one spike.
pulses.delivery: the 2-ms control step containing a pulse is split into a 1-ms step with the pulse current and a 1-ms step without; the rule still updates once per 2 ms on the summed counts

stimulus.response: MBON11 spike count summed over both MBON11 neurons, 0-1400 ms from odour onset, minus the count in the 1400 ms before odour onset (Hige 2015 counting window; spontaneous subtracted)
stimulus.depression: D = (R_pre - R_post) / R_pre per seed and odour; a seed with R_pre <= 0 for either odour makes the gates that use D INCONCLUSIVE (never excluded)

conditions.paired: OCT at t0 for 1000 ms; PPL101 pulses at t0 + offsets
conditions.backward: PPL101 pulses at t0 + offsets; OCT onset 500 ms after the last pulse (t0 + 2200 ms) for 1000 ms
conditions.dan_only: PPL101 pulses at t0 + offsets; no odour
conditions.odour_only: OCT at t0 for 1000 ms; no pulses
conditions.ppl101_silenced: as paired, but PPL101 receives SILENCE_DRIVE (-200) from t0 - 1000 to t0 + 3000 ms instead of the pulses

encoder.presentation: bilateral: both antennae receive the same odour (contralateral_fraction is therefore irrelevant)
encoder.note: The DoOR table, r_max_hz, noise_sd, spontaneous rates and drive inversion are exactly those of the named file at the named sha256. A run whose referenced file hashes differently is refused by the paradigm (implementation item I3).

decoder.rule: none: neural recording only (MBON11 spike counts)

calibration.target: mean over calibration seeds of D(CS+) = 0.80 (Hige 2015: 80 +/- 5.7 %)
calibration.search: bisection on log10(eta) over [1e-4, 1] per DAN spike, at most 20 evaluations; each evaluation runs the full paired protocol on all 5 calibration seeds
calibration.failure: if the target is not bracketed or not reached within tolerance, calibration FAILS, E1 does not run and the failure is recorded; no other parameter is changed to make it reachable
calibration.only_edit: the calibration commit writes calibration.result and nothing else; the confirmatory seeds are never used for calibration

seed_role: confirmatory seeds (fresh; disjoint from calibration seeds 100-104 and from E0 seeds 0-9); encoder per-cell noise

sensitivity_arms.status: reported only, run on the confirmatory seeds after the primary E1 run, never gating

gates.claim: Every paired, backward and DAN-only run delivers exactly one PPL101 spike per pulse per neuron (4 per neuron).
gates.basis: design precondition; not a literature value

gates.claim: PPL101 fires no spike during the clamp window of the silenced condition.
Paired: MBON11 depression to CS+ exceeds depression to CS- (95 % CI lower bound > 0).
Backward: CS+ response change within +/-10 % of pre-pairing (ratio of means).
gates.basis: Hige 2015 Fig. 1G-J: backward order has no effect; the +/-10 % tolerance is a judgement

gates.claim: DAN only: CS+ response change within +/-10 %.
gates.basis: model self-consistency (MB-R1 needs KC eligibility). Cohn 2015 reports potentiation from DAN activation alone, which MB-R1 cannot produce: a declared limitation

gates.claim: Odour only: CS+ response change within +/-10 %.
gates.basis: Hige 2015: odour alone does not depress; tolerance a judgement

gates.claim: PPL101 silenced: CS+ response change within +/-10 %.
Plasticity off: CS+ response change within +/-10 %.
No weight outside the declared plastic set changes, in any condition and seed.

reported.claim: Paired CS+ depression on confirmatory seeds next to Hige 2015 (80 +/- 2 x 5.7 %)
reported.basis: in-sample for eta (fitted on calibration seeds only), reported

reported.claim: Paired CS- depression next to Hige 2015 (27 +/- 2 x 7.1 %): out-of-sample test of odour specificity
reported.basis: eta was fitted on CS+ only; reported, not gated

reported.claim: MBON12 (gamma2alpha'1) CS+ response change after PPL101-only pairing (compartment specificity; reported)
reported.basis: Hige 2015: PPL1-gamma2alpha'1 pairing leaves gamma1pedc unchanged (the converse is not measured)

decision_rule: Harness rule (validation/harness.py VERDICTS). E1 passes iff every gate and physiology check passes on the confirmatory seeds; PASS_PROVISIONAL because the null tolerances are judgements. Sensitivity arms, CPU/GPU parity and the reported items never change the verdict.

hige2015neuron.citation: Hige T, Aso Y, Modi MN, Rubin GM, Turner GC (2015) Heterosynaptic plasticity underlies aversive olfactory learning in Drosophila. Neuron 88:985
values_read: MBON-gamma1pedc>alpha/beta OCT response 118 +/- 8.3 spikes before and 24 +/- 7.4 after pairing (n = 7); MCH 110 +/- 11 -> 83 +/- 14; counted 0-1.4 s, spontaneous subtracted; spontaneous rates not reported

cohn2015.citation: Cohn R, Morantte I, Ruta V (2015) Coordinated and compartmentalized neuromodulation shapes sensory processing in Drosophila. Cell 163(7):1742-1755
values_read: DAN activation alone potentiates KC->MBON transmission; paired with KC activity it depresses

census.citation: scripts/mb_circuit_census.py output, docs/design/mb_circuit_census.json (MaleCNS v1.0, sha256-checked against data-provenance/malecns_v1/source.lock.json)
